q: Some of our diesel was stolen. Do we still count it as our emissions?
title: Stolen diesel: count it or not
short: Only fuel you burn is your Scope 1. Stolen diesel is not, but you need evidence: a police complaint, a stock register showing the loss, or an insurance claim. Without that, a verifier will expect you to count all fuel bought, which is the safer choice.
audience: MSMEs with diesel tanks on site or on trucks

ul: A dated police complaint or FIR naming the quantity.
A stock register showing the gap between stock and use.
An insurance claim for the lost fuel.

p: Unexplained gaps between purchases and use are treated as consumption. Write down the reason for any exclusion so it survives review.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, verification of greenhouse gas statements (iso.org)
